title: Debenhams pickets continuing from April 2020
notes: 26 January contemporary radio report says pickets reached day 291; retrospective timeline describes April start and national locations. Redundancy rights and government intervention demanded. The 1,000/1,500 workforce is not simultaneous protest attendance. A May vote ending the dispute does not fix physical closure. National/local picket granularity and >=50 remain open.

start_date.summary: Pickets predate January by months; no exact onset day inferred from day counters.

state_target.summary: Taoiseach handling, government training offer and liquidation-law change discussed.

open_questions: Identify physical onset and closure for each assembly before setting event boundaries.
Verify assembly size separately from workforce and nationwide campaign.

title: George Nkencho mobilization beginning in December 2020
notes: Irish Times body says gathering near house on 30 December and station demonstrations from 31 December. It separately describes an executed 5 January station gathering of about 70, ending with bread distribution and invitation to return. Peoples Dispatch confirms a 13 January vigil with hundreds; RTÉ corroborating lead is blocked and remains search-only factual evidence. January gatherings are recorded here as continuity and phase evidence, without adding a daily event automatically. E003 and Drogheda E004/E007 require boundary review. Nkencho’s death/shooting motivated these protests; they are not protest state-response killings/shootings.

start_date.summary: Body lines 256–260 distinguish 30 December near-house gathering and next-day station protest.

january_phases.summary: About 70 on Tuesday 5 January; executed 13 January vigil reported as hundreds. These numbers are not transferred to other dates or locations.

open_questions: Resolve whether recurring separated assemblies require individual event candidates under missing Coding Procedure.
Physical end of the mobilization is not established.
